purpose: Hand-held Shanghai snack props with LOD + grip sockets, individually modelled 五香豆 (broad beans), detail renders. Standalone prop batch; no world integration, no repo changes.
authority: This file is the only authority for numbers. PLAN.md gives order and fallbacks. If a number is missing here, use the nearest verified value from inputs/ and record it in PROGRESS.assumptions.

toolsReadOnly.systemPythonWithPIL: python3 -X utf8 (PIL 10.2, numpy; Blender python has no PIL)

coordinateContract.glb: Y-up, +Z = item front (side that faces the character when held), origin = item ground-centre (rest pose on a table)
coordinateContract.blenderInternal: Z-up; design (x,y,z) -> Blender (x,-z,y); export with export_yup=True (same as inputs/geomlib.py)
coordinateContract.windingRule: outward normals; closed convex items must reach outwardShare >= 0.97 by the catalog check

socketSemantics.socket_rest: empty at origin, +Y up: where the item sits on a surface
socketSemantics.socket_grip: empty at the primary hand contact point. Local frame: +X = finger closing axis (pinch/grip direction), +Y = up in rest pose, +Z = points OUT of the item toward the palm/back of the hand
socketSemantics.socket_grip_2: second hand contact for carry class (bowls, plates, steamer, jar, box)

nodeLayout.collision: props/collision.json: per item a capsule or box in item-local Y-up metres; one shape per item (two for chopsticks-pair)

budgets.texturesPerItem: <= 1 colour 1024^2 (JPEG q92) + optional 1 normal 1024^2 (PNG or JPEG q95) baked from LOD0 detail; shared textures allowed and preferred
budgets.noWeathering: no dirt/aging; food is fresh (owner decision 2026-09-13/19)

beans.name: 奶油五香豆 (broad bean 蚕豆, sugar-frosted)

single.shape: flattened kidney ellipsoid; one long edge has a 6 mm dark hilum groove; skin has fine wrinkles (normal map baked from a displaced LOD0 or analytic wrinkle map); slight asymmetry
single.variantRule: scale 0.9-1.1 per axis, wrinkle seed, frost coverage 30-70%, hilum side flip; all six exported inside bean-single.glb as separate root nodes wuxiangdou-bean-v1..v6

bean-dish.arrangement: 3 gravity-free layers, hex jitter 15%, no pair closer than 0.85 * mean radius (assert)

bean-packet-open.vessel: kraft packet 0.09x0.12x0.032 torn open at top, 12 beans spilled on the ground within r=0.06

bean-jar.vessel: glass jar from inputs (r 0.078 h 0.215), beans fill to y=0.15
bean-jar.lodNote: LOD0 = individual beans merged into one primitive per material; LOD1 = the existing bean-mass lathe

renders.bean-lineup: 6 variants in a row, 2048x768, camera 0.25 m, f/4 DOF focused on v3
renders.bean-macro: single bean v1, 2048x1536, camera 0.09 m, DOF f/2.8, three light angles (key/rim/top) as 3 frames
renders.dish-jar-packet: each set 1600x1200 three-quarter, beans must be individually resolvable (assert >= 60% of beans have >= 25 px projected diameter in the jar close-up; record the measurement)

renderSpec.engine: Cycles; CPU default; CUDA only if nvidia-smi utilisation < 20% at start (record)

lightRig.fill: area light 40 W, 0.6 m, opposite side, 30 deg elevation

groupScenes.content: all items on one 1.2 x 0.8 m table, rest pose, 3 rows

renderSpec.blankFrameGuard: std of luminance < 2/255 or single colour > 95% => blank => non-zero exit, listed in RESULT.blankFrames
renderSpec.contactSheets: PIL: sheet per class + one all-items sheet, labels zh/id/LOD0 tris

perGlb: root node <id> with LOD0/LOD1/LOD2 mesh children and socket_grip + socket_rest empties (socket_grip_2 for carry)
socket_grip inside bounds expanded by 0.01 m; socket_rest at origin
reimport: every image node connected; colour sRGB, data Non-Color
outwardShare >= 0.97 for closed single items (bean, buns, tangyuan, cifangao, chunjuan, ligaotang-piece)
beanSets: no bean pair closer than 0.85 * mean radius
no bean vertex below vessel floor or outside the vessel inner radius (jar/dish)
renders: jar close-up bean resolvability measurement recorded
verification.tests: workspace/tests/*.py runnable with system python3 -X utf8; a single tests/run_all.sh must exit 0

allowedNewFiles: anything under workspace/ and artifacts/; nothing elsewhere
stopCondition: artifacts/snacks-handheld/RESULT.json with status delivered_for_lead_review, ownerAdopted=false; then stop
